children: Axiata associate XLSmart losses are expected to narrow further in 2H as accelerated depreciation tapers, Maybank IB analyst Tan Chi Wei says in a note. Axiata's holding-company losses are expected to remain volatile, but longer-term earnings recovery and balance-sheet repair could provide re-rating catalysts, he says. Assuming a 0.11 ringgit 2026 dividend, Axiata could offer a yield of about 6%, he adds. Maybank cuts Axiata's target price to 2.75 ringgit from 2.90 ringgit to reflect a lower valuation for associate CelcomDigi, while maintaining a buy rating. Shares are 3.3% lower at 1.76 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
